yt_title: Before you preorder an offline survival AI gadget, watch this
caption:
Don't preorder that offline survival AI gadget yet.

A saved reel pushed a preorder with no specs in the caption.
There's a free, open-source version of the idea: Project N.O.M.A.D. Offline Wikipedia, Khan Academy courses, offline maps and a local AI, on your own hardware.

Catch: you need a spare computer with plenty of storage.
